description: This file defines schema and class structures related to the 'beerocks_message' namespace, including classes such as tlvVsClientAssociationEvent, tlvVsChannelScanRequestExtension, tlvVsChannelScanReportDone, tlvVsOnDemandChannelSelection, and tlvVsBssidIfaceMapping. It specifies types, comments, and relationships among these classes, serving as a definition/specification file within a larger codebase.

classes.name: tlvVsClientAssociationEvent
classes.description: Represents a client association event, including MAC addresses, BSSID, vap_id, capabilities, and disconnect reasons.

classes.name: sScanRequestExtension
classes.description: Defines scan request parameters such as radio MAC and dwell time, used within scan request extensions.

classes.name: tlvVsChannelScanRequestExtension
classes.description: Contains a list of scan requests, with length specified by scan_requests_list_length.

classes.name: tlvVsChannelScanReportDone
classes.description: Indicates the completion status of a channel scan report.

classes.name: tlvVsOnDemandChannelSelection
classes.description: Represents on-demand channel selection information, including radio MAC and CSA count.

classes.name: tlvVsBssidIfaceMapping
classes.description: Provides BSSID to VAP ID mappings, with the number of mappings specified by bssid_vap_id_map_length.
